lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a semi-regular grid with vertical spacing between centroids roughly twice the diameter of the individual clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, elevated pixel intensity intersect with the discrete circular nodes, acting as vertical axes for the grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a low-intensity (shadowed) ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin displays a very low density of high-luminance blobs, appearing largely monochromatic with only faint, low-contrast luminance variations near the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, visible in the lower-left foreground, contains a high-density population of small-scale high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller than the primary flank pattern.
